:::::: card
## <i class="bi bi-question-circle-fill icon"></i> The Challenge

::: conetent-text
This project aims to collect waitlist data for R1 universities from multiple years of Common Data Set forms and analyze it to: (1) determine trends in the size of waitlists; and (2) determine trends in in the number of students admitted from the waitlist — with special attention given to how waitlist acceptance rates may have been affected by the pandemic. 
:::
